title: Sar peeto karo matam barpa duniya se uthi umme kulsoom
body:
Sar peeto karo maatam barpa, duniya se uthi umme kulsoom
Hai aale nabi me shoro buka duniya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo bhai ko apne roti thi, muh ashkou se apna dhoti thi
Ek pal bhi na jisko chain mila
Duniya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhai pe fida karne ke liye, qaaliq ne jise bete na diye
Abbas bane jiska fidya
Duniya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
Cheeni gayi jiske sar se rida, darbaar me jisko jaana pada
Seh seh ke masaaeb wo dukhya
Duniya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
Masroof rahi sheh ke gham me, din jisne guzaare maatam me
Padhti rahi har dam jo nouha
Duniya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha noke sina par bhai ka sar, sar par nahi thi jiske chaadar
Kyu kar na kare us par girya
Duniya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
Masroof e buka din raat rahi, zainab ke jo har dam sath rahi
Jo roti rahi bhai ko sada
Duniya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar peet te hai sab aale nabi, jo ghar ki muhafiz thi na rahi
Rote hai hassan sab ehle aza
Duniya se uthi umme kulsoom
